chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar from a man from Banu Ijl who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the place where dust is, and I blow it when I intend to prostrate, so he said, 'There is no harm.'

key_terms.لاَ بَأْسَ: there is no harm / it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to blow dust off clothes before prostrating in prayer?
ai.summary: Reported in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on prayer etiquette, this hadith clarifies the permissibility of removing dust from one’s body or prayer surface before *sujood*. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on ritual purity (*taharah*) and the removal of minor impurities that might distract from the reverence of prostration, affirming that such preparatory actions do not invalidate the prayer.
